speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided any symptoms yet. To begin, have you noticed any unexplained weight loss or fever alongside your fatigue and abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very concerning combination of symptoms. Given the weight loss and night sweats, have you noticed any enlargement of your lymph nodes, particularly in your neck or armpits? Also, have you experienced any changes in bowel habits or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin's or Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma).

REQUEST IMAGES: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with contrast.
REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, ESR, and TSH.
